title: Limits on new swimming pools in West Maui
summary: At the latest meeting, on September 17, 2026, a resident suggested that new West Maui pools could rely mainly on captured rainwater rather than drinking water. No other facts about the pools, their plans, or any decisions are available here, so the matter's wider status is unclear.
